reasons.detail: R1 — Added `checkRequiredWorktreeBranchFiles` call in `runPrepareWithPluginHooks` before any worktree/branch side-effect logic (including stale-flow cleanup, branch cleanup, and `git worktree add`).
R2 — Required file preflight checks `branchHasPath` against `resolvedBase` and returns `Envelope.fail` before side effects when the required file is absent.
R3 — `classifyRequiredBranchFile` inspects `git status --porcelain` for staged/unstaged/untracked states and fails fast before execution when present.

R4 — Failure path returns `Envelope.fail(...)` with required file issues (path/status/reason) and recovery options `commit-and-continue` and `abort`, while run-id prepare-state deletion still occurs later, so state remains intact on halt.

R5 — For clean reflected config, preflight passes and existing `useWorktree` flow continues unchanged: worktree creation, spec artifacts, docs scan, `.senti/config.local.json` overlay copy, and plugin runtime sync remain in place.
R6 — Preflight is gated by `useWorktree`; no-branch and normal branch modes are untouched, and no new config-file copy/commit logic is introduced.
